title: Nazb Darya Par
body:
nazb darya par shahe bekas ka qaima ho chuka
manzilein aafat pa pardesi ka dera ho chuka
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj apni waada gah sadiq ul wbaad aa gaye
ab jo hona hai wo hoga tha jo hona ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nehr ki thandi hawa aati hai jab bemaar ko
kehte hai sajjad ay baba mai acha ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri ghar ke liye lete hai hazrat kuch rabeeb
karbala mein hashr tak maloom rehna ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
naizo o shamsheer o khanjar jama laakhon ho chuke
dawat e mehman ka sab saaman muhayya ho chuka
nazb darya par...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu e abbas ke lete hai bosay baar baar
shaah par kya jaaniye kya raaz afshan ho chuka
nazb darya par...
